place.en: Black Pine Ridge · the sky turns

_weather: 「暴雨砸了下来」「雷雨前翻起来的土腥」

setup.zh: 鸟忽然全停了，风里一股铁锈味，山梁上的云往下压。蹄印还新，鹿就在前面。
setup.en: The birds stop all at once; the wind smells of rust; cloud presses down over the ridge. The tracks are fresh, the deer just ahead.

recap.zh: 天变了。第三条规矩：掉头就跑——暴雨砸了下来。
recap.en: The sky turned. Rule three: turn and run — and the rain came hurling down.

zh: 鸟不叫了。风里有铁锈的味道。
en: The birds have stopped. The wind smells of rust.
Over the ridge, the clouds are coming down.

story.zh:
林子深处，忽然从头顶上不知什么地方，传来一声长长的鸟啼，拖着一个尾音，又细又远，听在耳朵里，竟像是有个人在很远很远的地方，一声一声地喊：「……回来……」他爹站住了，偏着头听了一听。那声音叫了三声，便不叫了。他爹道：「山鹧鸪。叫起来像人。山里有东西喊你，千万别应声。」说完便低下头去，接着看那蹄印。

小满在心里算了一算：鸟是山鹧鸪，有了着落，算不得「不对劲」，第三条规矩，用不着。可他把刀攥得更紧了。
story.en:
Deep in the forest, from somewhere overhead, came a long bird call, trailing off at the end, thin and far away. In the ear it sounded like someone a long, long way off, calling over and over: "…Come back…" His father stopped and tilted his head to listen. The call came three times and then stopped. His father said, "Hill partridge. Sounds like a person when it calls. If something in the mountains calls your name, whatever you do, don't answer." With that he bent his head and went back to the hoof prints.

Xiaoman worked it out in his head: the bird was a hill partridge. It had an explanation, so it didn't count as "something wrong", and the third rule wasn't needed. But he gripped his knife tighter.

story_after.zh:
后来，是小满先觉出不对的。鸟不叫了——不是黑松岭那种一直没有的静，是方才还有几声，忽然之间全停了，如同有人一把捂住了整座山的嘴。风里飘过来一股味道，像铁锈，又像雷雨前翻起来的土腥。

先看风——他抬头看时，树梢一动不动，天边那道山梁上的云却正往下压，压得又低又黑，好似一口倒扣过来的大铁锅。

他一把拉住他爹，道：「爹，第三条规矩。」他爹也看见了。他爹看了看天，又看了看前面，蹄印还是新的，鹿就在前头，也许再走半里地便能瞧见了。
story_after.en:
In the end it was Xiaoman who felt it first. The birds had stopped — not the silence that had always been on Black Pine Ridge, but a few calls a moment ago, and then all at once nothing, as if someone had clapped a hand over the mouth of the whole mountain. A smell drifted on the wind, like rust, or like the earth that turns up before a thunderstorm.

First read the wind — he looked up. The treetops weren't moving at all, but the clouds over the ridge at the edge of the sky were pressing down, low and black, like a huge iron wok turned upside down.

He grabbed his father. "Pa, the third rule." His father had seen it too. He looked at the sky, then ahead. The hoof prints were still fresh. The deer was just in front; perhaps another half li and they'd see it.

label.en: The third rule: turn and run

exits.means: turns back at once as the rule says, runs for the marks

story.zh:
一张鹿皮，二十斤肉，墙上那张弓，还剩两天——小满看见他爹咬了咬牙，转过身来，道：「走吧，咱们回去。」

两人往回便跑，小满认着记号一道一道往回数，四十一，四十，三十九……便在这时，天塌了。跟着雨便砸下来了——不是下，是砸。

眨眼之间，山路成了河。小满看不清三步以外的东西，只看得见他爹一瘸一拐的背影，在雨幕里一晃一晃。
story.en:
One deer hide, twenty catties of meat, the bow on the wall, two days left — Xiaoman saw his father clench his jaw, then turn round. "Come on. We're going back."

The two of them ran back the way they'd come. Xiaoman counted the marks back, one by one: forty-one, forty, thirty-nine… And then the sky fell in. Then the rain came smashing down — not falling, smashing.

In the blink of an eye the mountain path became a river. Xiaoman couldn't see more than three steps ahead. All he could see was his father's limping back, swaying in and out of the curtain of rain.

story_full.zh:
一张鹿皮，二十斤肉，墙上那张弓，还剩两天——小满看见他爹咬了咬牙，转过身来，道：「走吧，咱们回去。」

两人往回便跑，小满认着记号一道一道往回数，四十一，四十，三十九……便在这时，天塌了。前一刻还有一线光从树缝里漏下来，后一刻林子里已是漆黑一团，好似有人扯过一块比天还大的黑布，把整座蒙山一把蒙了起来。

风从山顶灌将下来，满山的黑松一齐弯下了腰，呜呜地响，像整座山都在哭。跟着雨便砸下来了——不是下，是砸。雨点有黄豆那么大，打在脸上生疼，打在树叶上噼里啪啦，像有一千个人同时在放炮仗。

眨眼之间，山路成了河，泥水裹着碎石，直往山下冲去。小满看不清三步以外的东西，只看得见他爹一瘸一拐的背影，在雨幕里一晃一晃。
story_full.en:
One deer hide, twenty catties of meat, the bow on the wall, two days left — Xiaoman saw his father clench his jaw, then turn round. "Come on. We're going back."

The two of them ran back the way they'd come. Xiaoman counted the marks back, one by one: forty-one, forty, thirty-nine… And then the sky fell in. One moment there was still a thread of light leaking through the trees, and the next the forest was pitch black, as if someone had pulled a black cloth bigger than the sky over the whole of Mount Meng in one go.

Wind poured down off the peak, every black pine on the mountain bent at the waist together and moaned, as if the whole mountain were crying. Then the rain came smashing down — not falling, smashing. Drops as big as soybeans, stinging on the face, crackling on the leaves like a thousand people letting off firecrackers at once.

In the blink of an eye the mountain path became a river, muddy water carrying broken stones, rushing straight downhill. Xiaoman couldn't see more than three steps ahead. All he could see was his father's limping back, swaying in and out of the curtain of rain.

refuse.zh: 林子里还有鸟叫——先听，再看风。
refuse.en: The birds are still calling — listen first, then look to the wind.

exits.means: keeps chasing the deer a little further before turning back

story.zh:
一张鹿皮，二十斤肉，墙上那张弓，还剩两天——小满看见他爹咬了咬牙，道：「半里。就半里。」

两人又追了半里。林子深处，一截鹿角在树后一闪——便在这时，天塌了。

前一刻还有一线光从树缝里漏下来，后一刻林子里已是漆黑一团；风从山顶灌将下来，满山的黑松一齐弯下了腰，呜呜地响；雨砸下来，不是下，是砸，眨眼之间，山路成了河。

多追的那半里，这时候要在泥水里一步一步还回去。小满认着记号往回数，数得比去的时候慢得多。
story.en:
One deer hide, twenty catties of meat, the bow on the wall, his mother's hand stopped in mid-air — Xiaoman saw his father set his jaw. "Half a li. Just half a li."

They chased another half li. Deep in the forest a tine of antler flashed behind a tree — and then the sky fell in.

One moment a thread of light still leaked through the branches; the next the forest was pitch black; wind poured down from the peak and every black pine bent double, moaning; the rain came down — not fell: hurled — and in the blink of an eye the path became a river.

The extra half li now had to be paid back step by step through the mud. Xiaoman counted back by the marks, far slower than on the way in.

refuse.zh: 林子里还有鸟叫——先听，再看风。
refuse.en: The birds are still calling — listen first, then look to the wind.

_beats: 听 (storm-listen, batch two 2026-10-14): played at the end of the passage — the birds calling in the pines stop all at once; 「不对」 the moment it goes quiet, then the sign in the sky (the cloud on the ridge, not the still treetops or the prints); grade sharp · late → `listen-sharp` · `listen-late`; 掉头 and 再追半里 both wait for it and stay his choice
